rules.cwe_name: Weak Password Recovery Mechanism for Forgotten Password
rules.description: Using the HTTP Host header to construct a link in an email can facilitate phishing attacks and leak password reset tokens.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of CRLF Sequences ('CRLF Injection')
rules.description: Untrusted CR or LF characters are not neutralized before use in line-delimited protocol metadata.

rules.cwe_name: Reliance on Untrusted Inputs in a Security Decision
rules.description: Comparing different kinds of HTTP request data may be a symptom of an insufficient security check.

rules.cwe_name: Sensitive Cookie Without 'HttpOnly' Flag
rules.description: Sensitive cookies set by a server can be read by the client if the `httpOnly` flag is not set.

rules.cwe_name: Off-by-one Error
rules.description: An array index is compared to be less than or equal to the 'length' property, and then used in an indexing operation that could be out of bounds.

rules.cwe_name: Modification of Assumed-Immutable Data (MAID)
rules.description: Security-critical data assumed immutable can be modified by an attacker.

rules.cwe_name: Time-of-check Time-of-use (TOCTOU) Race Condition
rules.description: Separately checking the state of a file before operating on it may allow an attacker to modify the file between the two operations.

rules.cwe_name: Inconsistent Interpretation of HTTP Requests ('HTTP Request/Response Smuggling')
rules.description: Using an insecure http parser can lead to http smuggling attacks.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Encoding or Escaping of Output
rules.description: Replacing a substring with itself has no effect and may indicate a mistake.

rules.cwe_name: Incorrect Type Conversion or Cast
rules.description: Assigning to a property of a primitive value has no effect and may trigger a runtime error.

rules.cwe_name: Creation of Temporary File With Insecure Permissions
rules.description: Creating a temporary file that is accessible by other users can lead to information disclosure and sometimes remote code execution.

rules.cwe_name: Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor
rules.description: Directly sending file data in an outbound network request can indicate unauthorized information disclosure.
